Text: I know you were hoping to relax, but first, lemme explain how to use the hangar.
In the hangar, you can put weapons and items in storage...
As well as set up your backpack and modify your Koubu.
Changing your loadout, such as your Koubu’s weapons and equipped skills...
All that can also be done at the Hangar.
Of course, you can also change your skills and equipped weapons while on the field, too.
Could you explain it in a bit more detail?
Could you tell me more about equipping weapons?
Alrighty, then, equipping weapons. I’ll go over it in order.
1. Put the weapon you want to equip in your backpack.
2. From your backpack, select the weapon you want to equip.
That’s the procedure for equipping your weapons.
Could you tell me more about setting skills?

Setting skills, huh?
You can do all that from your backpack.
1. Select the weapon you want to set your skills to from your backpack.
3. Select the skills you want to set to your weapon.
That’s the procedure for setting your skills.
